name: Lung Badge Reels with Badge Holders (3 Pack)
seoTitle: Lung Badge Reel 3 Pack for Nurses
metaDescription: A 3 pack of retractable lung badge reels with badge holders and alligator clips. A fun, budget friendly gift for pulmonary and student nurses.
summary: Three retractable lung themed badge reels with holders, a fun nod to respiratory and pulmonary care for nurses and students.
whyItWorks: Badge reels are a big part of nurse culture. Everyone has to wear an ID, swipe into med rooms, and tap a badge to scan in, so the reel gets pulled dozens of times a shift. Many nurses use it to show a bit of personality, and a lung design is a playful nod for anyone who works in pulmonary, respiratory, or critical care. Respiratory therapists will appreciate the theme too.

A 3 pack is practical in a way a single reel is not. Badge reels wear out, get lost, or end up left on yesterday's scrubs, so a backup or two is genuinely handy. The included badge holders also help protect the ID card itself. For a nursing student starting clinicals, it can be their first real badge setup, and the alligator clip lets them attach it to a scrub top or lanyard. It is a budget friendly gift that pairs well with a pen light, stethoscope tag, or a card for the start of a new job.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to see whether all three reels share the same lung design or vary.
Some hospitals require breakaway lanyards or specific badge holders, so the reel is best attached to whatever setup their facility allows.
Pair it with other small badge accessories for a simple clinicals starter gift.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes. Students wear ID badges on clinicals, and a retractable reel with a holder is one of the first things they need.
It is a fun theme for respiratory therapists and nurses in pulmonary, ICU, or step down units, though any nurse who likes anatomy themed gear will enjoy it.
